description: Transcribe meetings, interviews, podcasts, and calls with accurate speaker labels using Yaps.

defaultPrompt: Transcribe this meeting and identify each speaker.
Create a speaker-labelled transcript from this interview.
Correct the speaker labels in my Yaps meeting transcript.
interface.longDescription: Turn meeting audio or video into a timed, editable transcript with speaker labels using Yaps desktop. Sherpa works cross-platform and accepts an optional speaker count. On Apple Silicon, MOSS offers a fast local option for longer meetings. Review, correct, reassign, rename, and export the same meeting project from Codex or the Yaps app. Requires a local-capable ChatGPT Desktop Work or Codex session; ChatGPT web and cloud sessions cannot reach the installed Yaps engine. Users can also run the feature directly in Yaps.

name: yaps-meeting-transcription
